It was a hot 70F day. The sun beat down on her as she exited her SUV, hearing it creak as her weight shifted. It was a long walk to the door. Probably a good 7 or 8 feet. Handicapped spaces should really be closer to the door, she thought. She felt the sweat on her brow and began to hobble inside.

It was too hot, she would need to nourish her body with a Mountain Dew in the air conditioned cool of the McDonald’s. But first she had to make the hike in. One foot shuffling in front of the other, she jiggled her way to the door and caught a glimpse of her mass in the glass door on her way to pull it open. No wonder I can’t find a man! No mere mortal could handle a voluptuous goddess like myself..

As she hobbled in she huffed audibly upon seeing the line. She had already been on her feet so long, a whole minute! Exhausted, she flumps her way over to the nearest table and steals a chair. Dragging it to where the line was, she sat and began her wait.

Every few seconds she would loudly declare how much the service sucks. Not to anyone in particular, just every now and again a proclamation of her disgust with their slowness. She NEEDED food and soon. She felt the starvation mode beginning to set in, felt her cells scream for fuel. It was beginning to be too much. It hurt so much, her stomach begging to be filled, her throat still parched from her march inside.

Right when she thought she couldn’t take it anymore, the skinny slowpoke of a cashier called out for the next in line. Not wanting to risk standing any longer, she took her chair with her to order. She began reciting her go-to afternoon snack order by memory. A Big Mac combo, large fries, large drink, a 10 piece chicken nug.. oh wait the 20 piece is on sale.. 20 piece chicken nugget, an oreo McFlurry, and a quarter pounder with cheese.

The exasperated cashier looked at her pointedly. “Ma’am we are no longer allowed to serve that food to people of your... er.. girth. We have salad without dressing if you still want to purchase something.”

“WHaT iN ThE hELL?!”

“Ma’am please, just calm down it’s the law now I could get arrested...”

“I NEED FOOD, YOU TWIG FUCK. DO YOU SEE ME? I AM WASTING AWAY”

She could feel it, there was not much time left, the starvation mode was beginning its final stage. She knew she even if she overcame this discrimination her food would not be ready in time. She felt the end creeping towards her. She wanted to say something poignant, something to encapsulate the struggles of her and her fellow thicc goddesses. She wanted to become a martyr, she wanted her story written in tumblr tributes of glory. She wanted to be an inspiration.

But as her body melted, and as she was being reduced to a puddle of lifeless grease, all that could come to her mind were four simple but important words, four words that had defined her existence on this earth... with her last breath she sputtered out,

Quarter pounder... with cheese

And she was gone. Not entirely, mind you. There was the chair that had become her death throne, caked in thick yellow grease that had flooded the nearby tile.

“Good god not again” sobbed the cashier inconsolably.

“I dont get paid enough to clean this shit.”
